notes:
Creature icons. 18 creatures that drop no trophy were rendering as a blank skull, because an icon is looked up through the trophy a creature leaves behind. The seven Deep North Aspects now show the Forsaken they echo, Kall Fimbulbringer shows Sacrificial Blood, and Fallen Warrior shows the orb it drops - it has no trophy at all, despite looking like it should. Bat and Shadow stay generic on purpose: nothing in the icon set resembles them, and a wrong icon is worse than an honest blank.

Weaknesses are graded again. Valheim rates weakness and resistance in two tiers and MegaLoad flattened both, so being VERY weak to something looked the same as being merely weak. 24 creatures were affected - every greydwarf is very weak to fire, Stone Golem to pickaxe, Bonemass very resistant to pierce. Those now read "Fire (very)".

Also in this release, via the data feed: storage capacity on chests, barrels, carts and boats; no-spawn radii for 51 build pieces (the workbench is a 20m cylinder, 200m tall); comfort groups alongside comfort, which is the half that decides whether a second chair does anything; The Elder restored to the creature list; and the Dvergr mages split into Fire, Frost and Support instead of four rows all reading the same.
